result.method: I scored each ad against the §7 anchors on their own terms: 5 means a pleasant catalogue look or two competing ideas, and 9 means the benchmark description. Competent, on-system work landed at 7 to 8.5, and product-only frames topped out around 7.5 on desire because they have no skin and no moment. I applied the automatic caps mechanically, counting the F2 card as one text element. For true size I measured each piece against body or object anchors at full resolution and estimated on-phone size from its share of the 1080 px width.

result.method: I scored each ad against the rubric's written 5 and 9 anchors, not against the other ads.
